title: feat(init): recover cloud repository purchase approval handoff
intent: Recover the reviewed cloud-init requested-seat and purchase-approval handoff onto accepted master; repair obsolete session assertions; preserve native governance and proof boundaries without deploying billing or claiming paid cloud is operational.
commit_message: chore(governance): preserve native billing preparation receipt
body:
Cloud init now records a requested GitHub repository and named-user roster, validates that request against the local origin, and provides the hosted purchase-approval link. This recovers the unpublished billing contribution and corrects its obsolete assumption that init creates a cloud session automatically.

## Changes

- Add `--cloud-repository` and `--github-users` to both init entrypoints and preserve the normalized request in non-secret configuration.
- Reject missing or duplicate usernames and repository/origin mismatches before writing configuration.
- Expose the fixed approval URL; human interactive init may open it, while headless, proof, and dry-run execution only prints it.
- Keep explicit session acquisition and backend entitlement checks authoritative. Regression coverage requires the approval link, no automatic session file, no leaked mock credential, and no readiness claim from init.
- Update the living specifications and preserve the accepted verification, Laya, and documentation work.

## Provenance and validation

Recovered source: [`26a499d9`](https://github.com/DecapodLabs/decapod/commit/26a499d9f0789a5ed00605d23cfc57f5392ae8fc).

Exact candidate: `{{HEAD_SHA}}`.
Accepted target: `{{BASE_SHA}}`.

The native publisher gates PR creation on complete validation of this exact candidate and target. The change does not modify CI, build definitions, or the controller contract; static patch checks are not publication proof.

## Rollout boundary

This preserves the existing USD15 per named user per repository monthly purchase-intent contract. It does not deploy billing or establish that paid cloud is operational. Propodus billing deployment, GitHub admin verification, Stripe configuration and sandbox acceptance, and released client credential/route support remain prerequisites in `docs/cloud-repository-billing.md`. A roster entry or approval link cannot grant access.
